description: This file defines a CameraCaptureService actor in Swift, providing functionalities for listing camera devices, capturing photos, recording videos, and managing camera access and configuration, primarily for macOS platforms.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling photo capture callback, converting AVCapturePhoto to Data.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling video recording completion, providing URL of saved file.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo from the selected camera with specified parameters, returns image data and size.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip from the selected camera, optionally including audio, saves to specified path, returns filepath, duration, and audio presence.

methods.name: ensureAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests camera/microphone access permissions asynchronously.

methods.name: availableCameras
methods.description: Returns a list of available video capture devices.

methods.name: externalDeviceType
methods.description: Determines external camera device type based on platform version.

methods.name: pickCamera
methods.description: Selects a camera device based on facing direction or device ID.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps quality value within acceptable range.

methods.name: normalizeSnap
methods.description: Normalizes max width and quality parameters for snapshot.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps video duration within allowed bounds.

methods.name: exportToMP4
methods.description: Exports recorded video to MP4 format asynchronously.

methods.name: waitForExposureAndWhiteBalance
methods.description: Waits for camera exposure and white balance to stabilize.
